europe.title: Gunman ‘fascinated by far-right’ kills six in Krakow, Poland
europe.summary: Tusk called the shooting an act of "terrorism"

ai.sum: A gunman fascinated by the far right killed six people in Krakow, which Tusk called terrorism.

europe.title: Kraków shooting latest updates: five killed and more than a dozen injured, police say
europe.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, in a post on X, said police are investigating the attack Tom Rose, the US ambassador to Poland, wrote on X: We are just learning details of the horrific mass shooting in Kraków, a savage and murderous attack that’s shattered the peace of Poland. America stands with Poland at this dark hour as Poland stands with her beloved citizens of Kraków. A terrible tragedy in Kraków’s Main Market Square. I share the grief of the families and loved…

ai.sum: A mass shooting in Kraków, Poland, has killed at least five people and injured more than a dozen, with police investigating.

europe.title: Life in Kyiv becoming increasingly difficult – EU ambassador on Russian missile strike
europe.summary: EU Ambassador to Ukraine Katarína Mathernová has commented on the latest Russian missile strike on Kyiv, highlighting the harsh reality of blackouts.

ai.sum: EU ambassador to Ukraine comments on the latest Russian missile strike on Kyiv and resulting blackouts.
